ambient_events: A shower head somewhere down the row coughs, spits, and gives up.
Water finds the trench drain and goes down it in a long, unhurried gulp.
The extractor fan changes pitch for no reason and then changes back.
Somewhere above, a boot scuffs concrete and stops directly overhead.
description: The wash block, one open room with no doors on anything and a trench drain running the length of the floor. Six shower heads on a single pipe, four of them working, all of them on the same municipal timer. The tiles were white once and are now the colour of a bad tooth, and the grout has gone black in a way that scrubbing has already been tried on. A sheet of polished steel bolted where a mirror should be gives you back to yourself smeared and slightly wrong. There is nowhere in here to stand where you cannot be seen from the doorway, which is the entire design. The cell block is back west.
name: Wash Block
